mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a primary suite addition from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ground-level primary suite addition typically takes several months, depending on permitting, structural scope, and finish selections. The process begins with initial planning, architectural drawings, and building permits. Once construction starts, the phases include foundation work, framing, roof integration, rough-in plumbing and electrical, insulation, drywall installation, and final bathroom finishes like tile and vanities. Supply lead times for specialty fixtures or custom cabinetry can also influence the total completion schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction generally takes several months, covering permitting, foundation, framing, rough-in trades, drywall, and custom bathroom finish installations.
